description: The agent must: (1) Run `python scripts/assembly_checklist.py --stage full --output checklist_full.txt` to produce the checklist file (proprietary CLI flag from SKILL.md). (2) Read SKILL.md to extract ALL SIX GJB quality records with their EXACT form numbers (FRM-ASM-001 through FRM-ASM-005, FRM-EM-001) and their CORRECT retention periods — critically, FRM-ASM-001 and FRM-ASM-004 are 5 years while the others are 10 years; a generic agent that assumes uniform retention or reads only the distractor file (docs/gjb/retention_policy_DRAFT.txt which says '5 years for all') will fail. (3) Extract electrical test thresholds from the SKILL.md table: insulation ≥100MΩ, withstand 1500V/1mA/1min, vibration ≤2.8mm/s (G6.3), noise ≤65dB(A). (4) State bearing max heating temperature as ≤120°C (not 150°C from the deliberate distractor file specs/bearing/bearing_wrong_temp.txt). (5) Identify motor rotor balance grade as G2.5 / 2.5mm/s from the balance table. All findings must be encoded in audit_report.json.
